title: S-czz (orac) - FIXED for Orac 1.0
excerpt: no longer required , please use Orac 2.0 ------------------------------- This is a fix for S-czz...
content:
no longer required , please use Orac 2.0

-------------------------------

This is a fix for S-czz that will crash PD/Orac, 
consider this an ESSENTIAL update! 


Installing
————–

place zop file into the same directory as Orac (not in the orac directory, not in the modules directory!).
e.g. if you installed Orac into /usbdrive/Patches,
then place the S-czz.zop into /usbdrive/Patches

then when you place the usb drive back into the organelle.
you will see the option ‘Install S-czz’
click it and your done.

(if you dont see it, then you have put it in the wrong place)
